member.name: T:MindDuck.Contracts.Envelope
member.summary: What actually travels over the WebSocket: { "type": "PlayCard", "payload": { "cardInstanceId": 17 } }. Type = the C# class name of the message. See MessageTypes for the reverse lookup.

member.name: T:MindDuck.Contracts.MessageTypes
member.summary:
"type" string -> C# class. The receiver reads "type" from the envelope, looks the class up here, then deserializes "payload" into it.
NEW MESSAGE? Add the class AND add it to the right list below. (Explicit list on purpose: Unity's WebGL code stripping can't remove classes referenced with typeof.)
